correct_completion: had the company faced such a serious financial crisis.
full_sentence: Never before in its history, had the company faced such a serious financial crisis.
acceptable_variants: had the company ever faced such a serious crisis.
had the organisation faced such a serious financial crisis.

options.text: the company has faced such a crisis.
options.why_wrong: After a fronted negative phrase such as 'Never before', the auxiliary must come before the subject, so the normal word order is incorrect here.

options.text: had the company faced such a serious financial crisis.
the company had faced such a crisis.
options.why_wrong: The subject still comes before the auxiliary; inversion is required after the fronted negative adverbial.

options.text: did the company face such a crisis.
options.why_wrong: 'Did' is the wrong auxiliary here; the stem needs the past perfect 'had' followed by a past participle.

grammar_focus: Subject-auxiliary inversion after fronted negative adverbials
explanation: Fronting a negative adverbial requires inversion, so the auxiliary 'had' must precede the subject. Turkish speakers often keep the normal subject-verb order because Turkish has no auxiliary inversion of this kind.
